description: SahayakHub routing verdict. Every field is always present. Status rules: ready = at least 1 delivery, no pending entity, block_reason null. needs_verification = no deliveries, exactly 1 pending entity, block_reason null. blocked_by_tier = no deliveries, no pending entity, block_reason set. no_action = no deliveries, no pending entity, entity_update null, block_reason null.

status.description: The verdict. ready: deliveries are authorised. needs_verification: freeze the task and ask about one unresolved person. blocked_by_tier: a free/paid ceiling was exceeded. no_action: nothing to deliver or ask.

block_reason.description: Set only when status is blocked_by_tier; null for every other status.

pending_entities.description: Emit [] unless status is needs_verification, in which case exactly one element.

name.description: Known contact name exactly as given, or the unknown name as typed in Roman letters.

question_text.description: One of the fixed verification questions with [Name] substituted.

entity_update.description: Non-null only when answering an open verification (ready, needs_verification or blocked_by_tier); null for no_action and for normal messages. Fields the user did not state are null.

designation_english.description: English Title Case, letters, spaces and hyphens only, at most 40 characters.

deliveries.description: Emit a formal empty array [] for every status except ready (never null, never omitted); at least 1 element when status is ready. One per distinct recipient.

sender_phone.description: Copied verbatim from the input; null stays null.

sender_bsuid.description: Copied verbatim from the input; null stays null.

recipient_contact_id.description: A contact_id from known_contacts or the resumed entity_contact_id (digits only); never invented.

relationship_designation_english.description: English Title Case, letters, spaces and hyphens only, at most 40 characters.

streamlined_translated_message.description: Short polite WhatsApp text in the recipient's language profile; no emoji; no added information. Every inner double quote must be escaped as \" in the JSON string.
